name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny trend line without axes for beside a figure or in a table cell, with a dot on the latest point, a tooltip and a 44 px keyboard and touch target however thin it is.

props.name: data
props.description: The values, oldest first: plain numbers or `{ value, label? }`.

props.name: label
props.description: The chart's accessible name, such as "Savings, last 30 days". The trend is read after it.

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the tooltip, the summary and the table.

props.name: width
props.description: A fixed width in px. Default the container's full width.

props.name: height
props.description: The height in px. Default 30, and 24 in a compact tile.

props.name: current
props.description: The index of the point marked with the signal dot. Default the last point; null for none.

props.name: domain
props.description: The values at the bottom and top of the box, to put several sparklines on one scale. Default each line's own min and max.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Show a tooltip and read points by hover, touch and keyboard. Off draws a still image. Default true.

props.name: table
props.description: Put the points in a hidden table for screen readers. Turn it off inside a table row. Default true.

props.name: delay
props.description: Wait this long (ms, at most 300) before the first-view wipe, to stagger several lines. Default 0.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a breathing placeholder line instead of data.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: The highlighted point (an index into `data`), or null.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: The highlighted point to start with, when `activeIndex` is not controlled. Default null.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called when hover, a finger or the keyboard picks another point, and with null when it lets go.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible and spoken string that is not data.

a11y.text: With interactive (default true) the line is one Tab stop: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, Home and End step through the points, and Escape lets go. The hit area is at least 44 px.

The line is an image named by label plus a summary from labels. In the interactive case it is described by a hint. The table prop (default true) adds a hidden table; turn it off inside a table row. The loading and empty states change the name.
Under reduced motion the line is there at once.
